newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHARES TREAD WATER IN POSITIVE TERRITORY.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHARES TREAD WATER IN POSITIVE TERRITORY.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Dutch shares hold up in positive territory during
slack midsession. Initial impulse from higher surrounding
bourses, better Bund future holds up as dollar firms a touch
against guilder, although some investors take profits. Dealers
say trade very light and mainly driven by professionals. Most
players taking wait-and-see attitude ahead of fresh U.S.
macro-economic data later this week and Friday's options expiry
not seen affecting market until mid-week.
* AEX up 2.11 points at 782.92, back from 783.42 opening.
* Vendex announcement of Vedior listing by June
has little immediate impact, shares up 0.70 at 96.20 guilders.
